newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss April trade deficit revised to 287.3 mln Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss April trade deficit revised to 287.3 mln Sfr.

text.p: Switzerland's trade deficit in April has been revised to 287.3 million Swiss francs from the 305.9 million shortfall originally reported, the Federal Customs Office said.
Exports were revised to 9,298.5 million from 9,276.8 million, while imports were put at 9,585.8 million rather than 9,582.7 million.
Figures exclude precious metals, precious stones, art objects and antiques.
